# Auto Touch Click ⚡

Auto Touch Click is an iOS automation tweak built to record, replay, and manage touch actions through a clean control interface and stable runtime behavior.

It is designed for repetitive interaction testing, workflow automation, UI behavior checks, and controlled device-side automation.

The project focuses on reliability, smooth execution, and practical control over touch sequences without unnecessary complexity.

## Overview

Auto Touch Click allows users to create automated touch workflows directly on-device.  
Recorded actions can be replayed with consistent timing, making it useful for testing repeated UI flows, reducing manual interaction, and validating touch-based behavior across different scenarios.

The tweak includes a lightweight overlay, recording controls, playback management, and safeguards for cleaner execution during active sessions.

## Features ✨

- Record touch interactions directly from the screen
- Replay saved touch sequences with controlled timing
- Floating overlay for quick access and session control
- Start, stop, pause, and resume automation
- Runtime-safe design with cleanup handling
- Stable behavior across active sessions
- Smooth performance with minimal interruption
- Suitable for testing, automation, and repeated UI workflows

## Use Cases 🧪

- Repetitive touch testing
- UI workflow validation
- Automation of repeated actions
- Touch sequence recording
- Internal QA and debugging
- Accessibility-style interaction assistance
